_comment: 剧本专属的「冲突说法」词条。这些是通用规则（wardrobe.DEFAULT_NEUTRALIZE_RULES）
覆盖不到的、本剧本特有的整句写法。
★ 换剧本时：旧条目只是匹配不到、自动跳过（不报错、不影响渲染）；
新剧本的说法往这里加即可，**不需要改任何 Python 代码**。
1. 删断言，不补描述 —— 补「她穿挂颈缎裙」等于让模型再发挥一次。
2. 替换文本必须结构中立（不点名领子/前襟/腰带；参考服装有没有前襟取决于图）。
3. find 尽量写完整短语，别写裸词（裸 collar 会误伤取景样板句）。

exact.find: collar loose, leaning down to kiss him
exact.note: 删 collar loose（断言有领子）

exact.find: holding the garment she had just taken off, her collar open
exact.repl: holding the garment she had just taken off, the garment not yet fastened
exact.note: collar open → 中性说法 not yet fastened

exact.find: leg line, bare feet and open collar all in frame
exact.repl: leg line, bare feet and shoulders all in frame

exact.find: climbs on to the collar, which she lowers her chin to straighten
exact.repl: climbs on to her shoulders, which she lowers her chin to settle

exact.find: as she finishes the collar and raises her eyes
exact.repl: as she finishes settling the garment and raises her eyes

exact.find: puts the clothes she just removed back on one piece at a time
exact.repl: puts the clothes she just removed back on in one continuous motion
exact.note: one piece at a time → in one continuous motion

exact.find: bends to pick the last garment from the floor and straightens to tie it
exact.repl: bends to pick the garment from the floor and straightens, drawing it up over her hips
exact.note: 删 last（多件套）与 tie it（系带）

exact.find: it lingers a moment at the waist as the cloth closes,
exact.repl: it lingers a moment at her waist,
exact.note: 删 the cloth closes（腰带/系合）

exact.find: as she lifts a leg to arrange the garment and bends to smooth it
exact.repl: as she draws the garment up over her hips and smooths it
exact.note: 删 lifts a leg to arrange（穿脱动作）

exact.find: for every inch the cloth closes the camera gives an inch back
exact.repl: for every inch the garment settles the camera gives an inch back
